implementation_scope: Shared evidence-backed business-day counting only; not a complete automatic DMCC audit applicability or filing engine

sources.assessment: Definitions separate companies limited by shares from branches and describe Dubai business days. Articles 73.6 and 73.7 use different triggers and month/business-day periods. Dormancy and shareholder notices require separate treatment under 73.4-73.5 and 78.11-78.12. Article 77 permits authority modifications. These distinctions prevent treating a calendar-day offset as a complete DMCC audit rule.

Submission guidance includes subsidiaries and branches. Its group-auditor branch exception concerns approved-auditor requirements rather than a blanket submission exemption. Portal documents and manual review remain separate from software generation or actual filing.

limits: Retrieved original HTTPS bytes; no digital-signature or current legal completeness qualification is claimed.

Issue/update dates are not inferred commencement dates. Operative scope, authority directions, actual holidays, legal counting conventions and individual company status require separately reviewed evidence.
No approved-auditor list authentication, dormancy qualification, shareholder-notice eligibility, live portal filing or professional issuance was performed.
